The "Trucker" Deal
Arms deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Incorporated States of Nederlandse Staat
====================================================
With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Italian dutch agree to adhere to the following arms deal:
_T____________________R____________________U____________________C____________________K_
Military truck deal

1.a: Nordiheim will sell 1000 units of Trukker LT85-5/10 for the tottal price of 24'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.
1.b: Nordiheim will sell 1000 units of Semi Trailers with a load capacity of 10 Tons for the tottal price of 8'000'000 $ to the Italian dutch.

1.c: Nordiheim agrees to allow Italian dutch easy access to buy aditional Trukker LT85-5/10 aswell as Semi Trailers for them in addition to spare/replacment parts for these vehicles if they desire to.

1.d: The Trukker LT85-5/10 and the Semi Trailers will be delivered over the next 2 months, or sooner if possible.

1.e: Italian dutch will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any Trucker LT85-5/10 to other nations without first getting permission from the Council of Nordiheim with the exeption of members of the EEHP or THEP.

++++++------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+Trucker+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Signatory parties
+++++ The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim ++the two nations great signatories++ Imperial Diplomat of The Empire of Italian dutch
